anvilcraft_pullwires.configuration.title: Anvilcraft Pullwires Configuration
anvilcraft_pullwires.configuration.trans:
Controls when a pending manual connection is dropped (multiplier of manualConnectRange)
Once the aim goes beyond manualConnectRange * this value, the pending state is cleared
Auto-connect range in blocks (straight-line distance). 0 = this pole type never auto-connects
Maximum manual connect distance in blocks. 0 = manual linking disabled for this pole type
Ranges of the Cross Dimensional Pole: it supplies nothing and never auto-connects; disk linking only
Auto-connect range in blocks (straight-line distance). 0 = this pole type never auto-connects
Maximum manual connect distance in blocks. 0 = manual linking disabled for this pole type
Ranges of AnvilCraft's own Remote Transmission Pole. Its supply range stays in AnvilCraft's config.

Whether flipping a pole's SWITCH from OFF to ON resets its runtime values
and restores its suspended links, keeping the link definitions intact
This is the "switch restart" semantics
Adjusts settings related to connection ranges and redstone behaviour of Transmission Poles
Auto-connect range in blocks (straight-line distance). 0 = this pole type never auto-connects
Maximum manual connect distance in blocks. 0 = manual linking disabled for this pole type
Ranges of AnvilCraft's own Transmission Pole. Its supply range stays in AnvilCraft's config.
Auto-connect range in blocks (straight-line distance). 0 = this pole type never auto-connects
